questions: Are we allowed to move any number of stones from bag A to bag B, including zero stones, or must we move at least one stone per operation?
Can we move stones from a bag to itself? That is, can A and B be the same bag?
Is the operation allowed to create a bag with zero stones, or must each bag always contain at least one stone after each move?
Are we allowed to move stones from bag B to bag A in the same operation, or is the direction strictly from A (source) to B (destination)?
Do we consider the bag labels (1 to N) as part of the state for counting possible XOR values, or only the multiset of stone counts across bags?
Is the total number of stones preserved across operations, or can stones be removed or added?
Can we perform the operation sequentially an unlimited number of times, including intermediate states that might repeat?
Should the output count include the initial XOR value (before any operations) as one of the possible values?
